auto_dismiss_s.description: Hide the panel or notification after this many seconds; 0 keeps it until clicked
auto_dismiss_s.label: Auto-dismiss (s)

critical_color.description: Accent of the panel for critical warnings
critical_color.label: Critical color

critical_interval_min.description: Minutes between repeated warnings below the critical threshold
critical_interval_min.label: Critical repeat interval (min)

critical_threshold.description: At or below this level warnings repeat faster, use the critical color and always show the panel (in notification mode, only while Do Not Disturb is on)
critical_threshold.label: Critical threshold (%)

dnd_fallback.description: Show the panel instead of the notification while Do Not Disturb is on, since Do Not Disturb hides notifications
dnd_fallback.label: Panel when Do Not Disturb is on

interval_min.description: Minutes between repeated warnings while the battery keeps discharging
interval_min.label: Repeat interval (min)

simulate_percent.description: Pretend the battery is discharging at this level, to preview the warnings; 0 uses the real battery
simulate_percent.label: Simulate level (%)

sound.description: Play a sound with every warning
sound.label: Sound

sound_file.description: Sound to play with every warning
sound_file.label: Sound file

start_threshold.description: Warnings start when the battery is discharging at or below this level
start_threshold.label: Start threshold (%)

warning_color.description: Accent of the panel for low-battery warnings
warning_color.label: Warning color
